name: Nucraft Furniture Co
description: Nucraft Furniture Co. is an office furniture manufacturer based in Comstock Park, Michigan. George W. Schad started the company in Grand Rapids in 1945, first making solid walnut accessories for offices, including coat racks and letter trays. Over the following decades it added occasional tables, bookcases and desks, with much of its early growth coming from US government clients. Its current range covers conference, media and community tables, credenzas, lecterns, benches and private office casegoods, combining woodworking with built-in power and data options. Nucraft also takes custom orders, runs showrooms in Chicago and New York, and holds GSA contracts.
